# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CMakeLists.txt -- sample firmware using lib-build's cortex-m33-hard-fpv5-sp-d16 libraries.
#
# Generated by lib-build for variant cortex-m33-hard-fpv5-sp-d16 (arm-none-eabi).
#
# Expected flow:
#   cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=./toolchain.cmake
#   cmake --build build
# produces build/firmware.elf.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

project(firmware LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD   11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User code: swap your own sources in here.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(firmware
    src/main.cpp
    src/startup.c
    src/syscalls.c
    src/libcpp_threads.c
)

target_compile_options(firmware PRIVATE
    -ffreestanding
    -fno-exceptions
    -fno-rtti
    -ffunction-sections
    -fdata-sections
    -Wall
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Where the lib-build artifacts live. SDK_ROOT is set by the toolchain file.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_include_directories(firmware SYSTEM PRIVATE
    "${SDK_ROOT}/include/c++/v1"
)

target_link_directories(firmware PRIVATE
    "${SDK_ROOT}/lib"
    "${SDK_ROOT}/lib/baremetal"
    "${SDK_ROOT}/picolibc/lib"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Linking: order matters. crt0.o must be listed as an explicit input object
# so it lives in the final image; libc++/libc++abi come before libc which
# comes before the compiler-rt builtins archive.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_link_options(firmware PRIVATE
    -nostdinc++
    -nostdlib++
    -nostartfiles
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -T${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/memory.ld
    "${SDK_ROOT}/picolibc/lib/crt0.o"
)

target_link_libraries(firmware PRIVATE
    c++
    c++abi
    c
    m
    :libclang_rt.builtins-arm.a
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Post-build: produce a listing + size report so you can see what went where.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_custom_command(TARGET firmware POST_BUILD
    COMMAND llvm-size $<TARGET_FILE:firmware>
    VERBATIM
)
